notes: Thermal (FLIR white hot, black hot and night vision) now separates heat: open ground and sky read cool, streets cooler still, water coldest, buildings mildly warm, vehicles hot and people hottest. On the zoomed map the terrain cools and units and tracked enemy give off a heat bloom. Daylight TV and colour stay as they were

Popout menus fit their panel: no more sideways scrolling, section shortcuts wrap onto a second line, long names and buttons wrap instead of being cut off, and stat rows reflow. Drag the popout's outer edge to make it wider or narrower (double-click the edge to reset); on very large screens the text is a size up

Menus are shorter: standing explanations are tucked behind an i button in each menu header (one tap shows them everywhere), empty sections are left out (SITREP, Services, Battle damage), advisors no longer show placeholder lines, contracts drop the contractor names, and Settings opens with the long Keyboard, Credits and Multiplayer sections folded
One map reticle: the drone camera overlay no longer draws its own crosshair on top of the centre reticle
